flows.title: Create and publish a job
steps: The steps below are in Workable, which a signed-in person reaches at https://www.workable.com/signin.
Create the job manually in the job editor.
Type the job title, using an auto-suggested title where one fits, and select the department from the dropdown menu.
Set the job location: a city under Office location for an on-site or hybrid job, or at least a country or state under Employee location for a remote one.
Fill out the job description, requirements and benefits, check the targeting details at the bottom of the page, and click Save & continue to go on to the application form, or Save draft.
When ready, click Publish at the top right. A standard access member is prompted to send a publish request to an account admin instead.

flows.title: Add a candidate to a job by hand
steps: The steps below are in Workable, which a signed-in person reaches at https://www.workable.com/signin.
Open one of the job's stages, for example Sourced. The candidate is added to the stage being viewed.
Click Add candidates in the upper right, then click Add manually.
Enter the information you have about the candidate in the form and click Add to Sourced. A resume can be added later by editing the candidate's profile.

flows.title: Edit a requisition
steps: The steps below are in Workable, which a signed-in person reaches at https://www.workable.com/signin.
Navigate to the Hiring Plan dashboard and click the three dots to select Edit requisition.
Open, pending, approved and rejected requisitions can be edited by Hiring Managers and above, given that they can view the requisition.

On a filled requisition only Super admins and Recruiters can edit, and only the date fields — plan date, open date, fill date and start date — and any custom requisition fields. The job, the salary range, the requisition owner and the requisition hiring manager are non-editable there.

Navigate to your Hiring Plan settings, through the three dots menu, to check which fields require re-approval. Editing one of those sends the requisition through the approval workflow again before the change is finalized; on a filled requisition it never triggers re-approval.
